title: 第7章 诺亚没教养那就教他做回人吧-《同时被N个S级哨兵盯上怎么办》
content:
第(1/3)页

    两人把话说的很透。

    秦夙心里对谢尘无这小子的印象就更好了。

    等他把外显的污染特征都隐藏起来。

    两人低声随意的聊着天离开白噪音室，去疏导中心柜台签字走人。

    没想到刚到电梯口，谢尘无看到站在电梯间的几个人，神色突然一变。

    从温和无害，换上一副面无表情的冷脸。

    “哟，看看这是谁？”诺亚抱起胳膊，歪个脑袋，眯起一双棕色的眸子，对秦夙讪笑，“我们队伍的治愈型小向导，果然还是跟其他队伍的哨兵搞在一起了。是刚做完疏导么？怎么做的？”

    他非常油腻的抬起自己右手，往上面啾的亲了一口。

    诺亚：“有没有这样，嗯？”

    爸了个根的。

    秦夙心里爆粗了，这诺亚，第一次见面就欲行不轨。

    第二次见面更是对她来了个荡妇羞辱。

    她真想冲上去踹这王八蛋几脚！

    但只一个诺亚她都不可能打得过，何况那货身边还站着俩哨兵。

    一个身高能赶上离颂，足有两米多的男哨兵，穿着很体面的黑色哨兵军礼服，戴着阔沿帽所以看不出发型，只见他一脸肃穆之中，还瞥了诺亚一眼。

    低声提醒诺亚，“你想再被处罚一次吗？在白塔里还是收敛些吧。”

    嗯，感觉不是来挑事的，秦夙看这男的都顺眼了一丢丢。

    诺亚身边另一个人，就更有意思了，秦夙转眸之间，目光一下就被吸引住了。

    穿黑色作战服，但性别是女孩？

    女哨兵？

    她一度还以为这个叫纽DP75星的编号星球上，哨兵都是男的，向导才都是女的呢！

    这女孩儿留着一头浅棕色的齐肩卷发，一双眼睛圆溜溜的也在盯着秦夙看个没完，那目光很干净清透，没有半点敌对的意思。

    只不过两个女孩隔空在电梯间里对视，秦夙难免比较。

    对方身高足有一米八，虽然气场有点唯唯诺诺不太自信的样子，但这身材实在是太英气太飒了啊！

    女哨兵没让沉默持续太久，有点腼腆的走过来，“萧……不是，秦夙向导，你好，我叫蕾拉，是尤来亚小队的成员。初次见面，我……嗯……”

    犹犹豫豫的，她还是走到秦夙面前，主动弯腰握住了秦夙的手，“我很荣幸，请……请不要介意诺亚的失礼，他对萧岑向导的事一直耿耿于怀，他只是太伤心……”
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

The two of them talked very clearly.

Qin Su had a better impression of Xie Chenwu.

Waiting for him to hide all the obvious pollution characteristics.

The two left the white noise room chatting casually in a low voice and went to the counter of the counseling center to sign and leave.

Unexpectedly, as soon as he arrived at the elevator entrance, Xie Chenwu saw a few people standing in the elevator, and his expression suddenly changed.

From gentle and harmless, to a cold expressionless face.

"Hey, look who this is?" Noah crossed his arms, tilted his head, narrowed his brown eyes, and smiled sneer at Qin Su, "Our team's little healing guide is indeed getting involved with the sentries from other teams. Did you just finish the grooming? How did you do it?"

He raised his right hand greasyly and gave it a kiss.

Noah: "Is that so, huh?"

Dad has a deep roots.

Qin Su was furious, this Noah wanted to do something wrong the first time they met.

The second time they met, she was even more humiliated as a slut.

She really wanted to rush up and kick this bastard!

But she couldn’t defeat just one Noah, not to mention there were two sentries standing beside him.

There was a male sentry who could catch up with Li Song and was over two meters tall. He was wearing a very decent black sentry military uniform and a wide-brimmed hat, so his hair style could not be seen. He had a solemn look on his face and glanced at Noah.

Remind Noah in a low voice, "Do you want to be punished again? It's better to restrain yourself in the White Tower."

Well, I don’t feel like I’m here to stir up trouble. Qin Su is very pleased with this man.

The other person next to Noah was even more interesting. Qin Su turned his eyes and was immediately attracted to him.

Wearing a black combat uniform, but the gender is a girl?

Female sentinel?

She once thought that on this numbered planet called New DP75, the sentries were all men and the guides were all women!

This girl has light brown shoulder-length curly hair and a pair of round eyes staring at Qin Su endlessly. Her eyes are very clean and clear, without the slightest hint of hostility.

"It's just that the two girls looked at each other in the elevator room from a distance, and Qin Su could not help but compare.

The opponent is 1.8 meters tall. Although his aura is a bit submissive and not confident, his figure is so heroic and dashing!

The female sentry did not let the silence last too long, and came over shyly, "Xiao... no, guide Qin Su, hello, my name is Leila, I am a member of the Ulea team. This is the first time we meet, I... um..."

Hesitantly, she walked up to Qin Su and took the initiative to bend down and hold Qin Su's hand. "I'm honored. Please... please don't mind Noah's rudeness. He has always been worried about guide Xiao Cen. He is just too sad..."

title_en: Chapter 7: Noah is uneducated, so teach him how to be a human being - "What to do if N S-class sentries are targeting you at the same time"
